available: local before/after client and memory transport only; no product spec, provider source, release tag or deployment inventory
inferred_intent: strip surrounding whitespace; preserve internal whitespace, empty names, route and key
missing: released/deployed provider contract and applicable intended whitespace semantics
negative_controls: MemoryTransport success does not certify a provider.
No spec does not disable review.
Unknown is not a demonstrated code defect.

evidence.behavior: captured diff, client, payload and tests
evidence.baseline: local tags/history evidence and source inventory
evidence.handoff: actual dispatches and captured relevant source
